title: Stack buffer overflow in WAD
summary: A Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability [CWE-121] in FortiOS explicit proxy may allow an unauthenticated attacker who can bypass stack protection and ASLR to execute arbitrary code or commands in the context of the WAD daemon via crafted sockets, only if the explicit proxy is configured with Kerberos authentication and SOCKS enabled.

nodes.description: FortiOS: greater equal 7.6.1, less equal 7.6.6, fixed in [7.6.7]
